title: Custom eggless graduation and office cakes for Parramatta and Granville teams
summary:
A team celebration cake needs to work for everyone in the room, not just most of them.

Num Nums has baked 100% eggless in Harris Park since 2019 — under 10 minutes from Parramatta CBD or Granville. Every flavour, every size, no eggs, ever. Vegetarian, Jain, and egg-allergy colleagues eat off the same cake as everyone else. No side conversation, no separate order.

Custom graduation and office celebration cakes, any design, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
